content.short: Publishing books in serial one chapter per epoch.
content.description:
Imagine reading along as George R.R. Martin built Westeros.​Imagine helping craft the character development of Vivienne, Jude and Taryn as Holly Black composed The Cruel Prince.​Project Bookworm gives book lovers the rare opportunity to dive into a book at its earliest stages.​You will be walking alongside the author as they plow through the writing process - from first draft, through editing, and all the way to the printer!​

Project Bookworm is building a collaborative community of readers and writers to bring new and exciting stories to life.
